summary_md: **moneygomyhome ([@fly9i](https://x.com/fly9i/status/2116086203376365881))** open-sources **spark-engine**, a from-scratch tensor-parallel inference binary for NVIDIA DGX Sparks with custom EXL3/MoE kernels, RDMA all-reduce, FP8 KV and NVMe prefix cache, serving GLM-5.3-Flash on 2–3 Sparks, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 3, and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on one with an OpenAI-compatible API and 1M context; a follow-up credits the EXL3 path and links the repo ([fly9i/spark-engine](https://github.com/fly9i/spark-engine)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - fly9i/spark-engine: From-scratch EXL3 inference engine for NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10): GLM-5.3-Flash on two Sparks (TP2) + Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on one, OpenAI-compatible, 1M context, speculative decoding

relevance: Directly targets Richard's DGX Spark, including single-Spark serving.
